vocabulary.meaning: what on earth; just what; in the world (intensifier for questions, expressing surprise or curiosity)
various; all sorts of; many different things
to go around; to make the rounds; to tour

grammar: 遅かったじゃないか: じゃないか is used for mild accusation or pointing out something ('weren't you late?'). 一体〜んだい: 〜んだい is an old-fashioned/fatherly question form (combining んだ + い), commonly used by older male characters.

text: 夕食の準備ができてるよ / 運ぶね
translation: Well, dinner's ready. / Oh, I'll bring it over.

vocabulary.meaning: dinner; evening meal (more formal than 晩ご飯)
preparation; readiness
to carry; to transport; to bring over

text: だったら客間の準備を頼むよ
translation: In that case, can you get the guest room ready?

vocabulary.meaning: guest room; parlor
to ask; to request; to entrust with; to rely on (casual request)

grammar: だったら: casual conditional meaning 'if that's the case / in that case then.' A soft pivot to assigning a task.

text: はい / クラウドはくつろいでて
translation: Okay! / Cloud, just make yourself at home.

vocabulary.meaning: to relax; to make oneself comfortable; to feel at ease

grammar: くつろいでて: casual contraction of くつろいでいて (please be relaxing / make yourself comfortable). The 〜でて form = 〜でいて.

text: 欲張っちゃいけないよ
translation: You can't be greedy.

vocabulary.meaning: to be greedy; to want more than one's share

grammar: 欲張っちゃいけない: ちゃいけない is a contraction of てはいけない ('must not / you shouldn't'). The ちゃ comes from てしまう→ちゃ in some patterns, but here it's from ては→ちゃ specifically.

text: お待たせ / ご苦労さん / お腹すいただろう / ペコペコ
translation: Sorry to keep you! / Thanks for your hard work. / You must be hungry. / Starving!

vocabulary.meaning: sorry to keep you waiting (set phrase, short for お待たせしました)
thanks for your effort; good work (said to someone who has worked hard; note: can sound condescending if said to a superior)
to become hungry; to get hungry
starving; very hungry (mimetic word); also: bowing repeatedly in a fawning way

text: ね
translation: Starving! / Right?

text: 本当に立派になって
translation: You've really grown up.

vocabulary.meaning: splendid; fine; admirable; grown-up; respectable

grammar: 〜になって: the sentence trails off with the te-form, implying an emotional or reflective pause ('you've really become wonderful [and here we are...]').

text: そんなんじゃあれだね / 女の子もほっとかないだろう
translation: Looking like that... / The girls must be all over you.

vocabulary.meaning: can't leave alone; can't ignore; won't let go (contraction of ほっておかない, itself a contraction of 放っておかない)

grammar: そんなんじゃあれだね: a vague, hedging expression ('with something like that, it's, you know...'). あれ acts as a placeholder for something too obvious or awkward to state directly. ほっとかない: 放っておかない → 放っとかない → ほっとかない, a common colloquial contraction.

text: 別に / 都会にはいろいろ誘惑が多いんだろう
translation: Not really. / The city has... a lot of temptations, right?

vocabulary.meaning: not particularly; not especially; (with negative) nothing in particular
city; urban area; the metropolis
temptation; lure; enticement

text: ちゃんとした恋人がいれば / 母さん少しは安心できるってもんだ
translation: If you had a proper girlfriend, your mother could rest a little / easier.

vocabulary.meaning: proper; decent; respectable; legit
lover; boyfriend/girlfriend; romantic partner
relief; peace of mind; reassurance

grammar: 〜ってもんだ: an idiomatic expression meaning 'that's what it means to be ~' / 'that's how it is' / 'that's the way things should be'. Expresses a common-sense or socially expected conclusion.

text: 俺は大丈夫だよ / あんたにはね
translation: easier. / I'm fine. / You need someone... a little older, who can really push you

text: ちょっとお姉さんで / あんたをぐいぐい引っ張っていく
translation: along.

vocabulary.meaning: older sister; (here) an older woman; a woman slightly older than you
forcefully; persistently; with strong energy (mimetic word implying active pulling/pushing/leading)
to pull; to drag; to lead along; to push someone forward

text: そんな子がぴったりだと思うんだけどね
translation: along. / That's the kind of girl I think would be perfect for you.

vocabulary.meaning: perfect fit; just right; exactly suitable (mimetic)

grammar: 〜と思うんだけどね: 思う (I think) + んだ (explanatory) + けど (but/although, softening) + ね (seeking agreement). A very common Japanese softening structure for expressing opinions without imposing.

text: おのぞみどおり出ていくさ
translation: I'll leave, just like you wanted.

vocabulary.meaning: just as you wish; as per your request; as you desired
to leave; to go out; to walk out

grammar: さ (sentence-final): masculine particle expressing assertion or resignation, often with a slightly bitter or defiant edge. 'I'll leave, just like you wanted' — the さ implies an ironic or pointed acceptance.

text: 行くのかい / 七番街へ行くにはどうすればいい
translation: You're leaving? / How do I get to Sector 7?

vocabulary.meaning: how should I go about ~; what should I do to ~ (asking for a method/means)

grammar: 〜のかい: のか (explanatory question) + い (old-fashioned/gentle masculine question marker). Used by older male speakers; softer than のか alone.

text: 六番街を抜ければいいのさ / 簡単だろ / 途中に危ないところもあるけど / ソルジャーなら問題ないよ
translation: You just have to go through Sector 6. / Simple, right? / There are some dangerous spots on the way, but for a SOLDIER, it's no problem.

vocabulary.meaning: to pass through; to go through; to cut across
on the way; midway; partway through
no problem; not an issue

grammar: 〜ればいいのさ: 〜ればいい (just need to ~) + のさ (explanatory assertion, similar to のだ but more casual/masculine). さ adds a breezy, matter-of-fact tone.

text: もうとうな / あの子には
translation: Ex. / Please... don't get involved with her anymore.

vocabulary.meaning: to be involved with; to have to do with; to concern oneself with

text: もう関わらないでくれるね / わかった
translation: Please... don't get involved with her anymore. / Got it. / Thank you.

vocabulary.meaning: to be involved with; to get mixed up with; to concern oneself with

grammar: 〜ないでくれるね: a softer request than 〜ないでください. 〜てくれる (will you do for me) + ね (seeking gentle confirmation). 'You won't get involved, will you?' — phrased as a hopeful confirmation rather than a demand.

text: ありがとう
translation: Thank you.

text: おやすみなさい。
translation: Good night.

vocabulary.meaning: good night (polite); the casual form is おやすみ
